new_processes.definition: Counterparties asking for copies of transaction confirmation sheets for gas purchases.

new_processes.definition: Correcting which contract a meter's volumes are scheduled or allocated to for a month, including moving meters to gathering contracts.

new_processes.name: King Ranch restructure scheduling
new_processes.definition: Keeping King Ranch and the restructured Coastal/Exxon deals accurately scheduled and understood by the desk.

new_processes.name: POPS meter volume override
new_processes.definition: Requesting and making overrides of daily meter volumes in POPS using gas control data.

new_processes.name: Preliminary ledger review
new_processes.definition: Distributing monthly preliminary ledgers for review and changes before a deadline.

new_processes.name: Contract database maintenance
new_processes.definition: Terminating or setting up contracts in the Global contract system and checking attached deals.
